title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: charging a registered telex release request
content:
## Scope of application

Under the Bills of Lading and Transport Documents product, a registered telex release request is charged the tier's telex release fee to the documentation party once the release is effected. Booking the fee also closes the telex release request as completed.

## Entry condition

The full set of originals in circulation has been surrendered at the origin office, so that the document is surrendered and originals_ outstanding is 0, before the telex release fee is booked.

Read in business terms: the document must already show the status surrendered and no originals left outstanding. Where this is unmet, the telex release fee is not booked.

## Business effect

One call adds one telex release fee charge to the documentation account of the document, tied to the telex release request it charges and dated the current day, raises the documentation charges due by the amount and marks the telex release request completed. The customer then sees the telex release fee in the documentation history and the request shown as completed.

## How it is invoked

charge_telex_release_fee_be5da3ed is an internal tool used by the agent; unlock it first, then call it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| bl_id | Reference number of the transport document charged, as returned by the transport document lookup | Id text |
| booking_id | Reference number of the booking the document covers, as shown on the transport document record and returned by the booking lookup | Id text |
| request_id | Reference number of the telex release request on file for the document, as returned by the documentation service request lookup | Id text |
| amount_usd | The fee booked, in USD | Written to 2 decimal places, no currency sign |

## Return

A confirmation sentence naming the new documentation charge reference (an opaque text id beginning "btf_"), the transport document reference, the telex release request completed, the amount booked in USD with 2 decimal places and the documentation charges now due. The appearance of that sentence is the success signal.

## Points of judgement

- **Question:** Who is charged? **Answer:** The documentation party of the document.
- **Question:** The request is registered, but one original is still outstanding. **Answer:** The entry condition is not met, so the fee is not booked.
